name: succinate dehydrogenase complex flavoprotein subunit A

function.text: SDHA encodes succinate dehydrogenase [ubiquinone] flavoprotein subunit, mitochondrial. Annotated molecular activities include succinate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity and FAD binding. It participates in nervous system development and succinate metabolic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hereditary pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma (autosomal dominant); mitochondrial disease (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Paraganglioma; Gastrointestinal stromal tumor; SDH-deficient renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
